# A comment that tries to add an attribute

<!-- MDV-ANCHOR id="c_probe1234" -->
The comment on this paragraph has an author "kind" with a double quote in it. Where the sidebar
places that value inside an attribute without escaping quotes, the rest becomes a new attribute.
